function.name: DRAWING_COLOR
function.abstract: Select the colour with which the primitive graphs will be drawn with functions like .

description.p: This function allows to select the colour with which the primitive graphs will be drawn (routines that begin by DRAW...) so like the graphs of two colours created by .

In the case of graph modes of 256 colours (8 bits), the value of colour must be a number (interval 0-255). In the case of graph modes of 16 bits, the value is a codification of the components of the colour according of the video card an the graph mode. It is normal to use the function to obtain the codification of a concrete colour, or use a colour obtained by a function like .

However, it is possible to use to draw in a graph 8 bits even in 16 bits. In both cases, the primitive graphs will use a colour approximated to the specified by this function, it is equivalent to use the function . In oppositive case, it is not valid to draw over a graph of 16 bits in 8 bits, because the config of video card sets the exact format of the colour in 16 bits.
